SUMMARY

Seeking a challenging position in a company which will require me to utilize my skills and abilities to ensure the company’s success. I

am working as Network Escalation Engineer L1/L2 (Monitoring) at Eze Castle Integration since Oct 2020 it’s been 2 year 11 months here.

With the drive to learn new technologies, I started learning Networking and successfully completed my courses in CCNA Routing and

Switches and received certification. I followed it by completing CCNA Security and received certification. Right now, I have completed

CCNP Routing and working on Switching yet to be certified in CCNP Routing and Switching. Also Learning Palo Alto and FortiGate

Firewalls.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Network Engineer Bloom Energy India Private Limited

Nov 2025 – Present

Manage and support corporate and customer fleet networks across 800+ customer sites, deploying routers and switches to establish

IPSec tunnels for secure communication between customer environments, BloomEnergy Server boxes, and the corporate server

infrastructure.

Oversee the corporate network , handling internal user access, troubleshooting, and onboarding through Aruba ClearPass , Zscaler ZIA/ZPA , and other enterprise-grade platforms. • Administer and optimize m ulti-vendor technologies , including:

o Aruba ClearPass (TACACS/RADIUS) for authentication and policy enforcement o Aruba Silver Peak SD-WAN Orchestrator for WAN optimization and overlay management o Cisco Nexus Switches for data center switching and high-performance connectivity o Aruba WLC & Access Points for enterprise wireless deployments o Zscaler ZIA & ZPA for secure VPN and cloud-based access control

Deliver end-to-end network solutions ensuring redundancy, scalability, and secure connectivity across diverse enterprise and customer environments.

Provide operational excellence by resolving user complaints, optimizing onboarding workflows, and maintaining high availability across corporate and customer networks.

Manage and support corporate and customer fleet networks across 800+ customer sites, deploying routers and switches to establish IPSec tunnels for secure communication between customer environments, BloomEnergy Server boxes, and the corporate server infrastructure.

Oversee the corporate network, handling internal user access, troubleshooting, and onboarding through Aruba ClearPass, Zscaler ZIA/ZPA, and other enterprise-grade platforms. • Administer and optimize multi-vendor technologies, including:

o Aruba ClearPass (TACACS/RADIUS) for authentication and policy enforcement o Aruba Silver Peak SD-WAN Orchestrator for WAN optimization and overlay management o Cisco Nexus Switches for data center switching and high-performance connectivity o Aruba WLC & Access Points for enterprise wireless deployments o Zscaler ZIA & ZPA for secure VPN and cloud-based access control

Deliver end-to-end network solutions ensuring redundancy, scalability, and secure connectivity across diverse enterprise and customer environments.

Provide operational excellence by resolving user complaints, optimizing onboarding workflows, and maintaining high availability across corporate and customer networks.

Network Escalation Engineer L1/L2 (Monitoring) Eze Castle Integration, Bangalore, India

Oct 2020 – Nov 2025

My team does monitor and L2 Engineer Level troubleshooting to investigate all the alerts and validate them and if not, we route these

tasks to L3 Team and Senior Network Engineers. Monitoring tool what we use are ConnectWise Automate and WHATSUP GOLD to

monitor LAN’s and WAN's which are ICMP based monitoring. Logic Monitor for monitoring MSP’s who prefer with respect to SNMP

based monitoring. Manage and Pull reports from Logic Monitor.

• We also make necessary changes with respect to VLAN’s, Policies and check IPSEC tunnels and initiate them. And modify firewall

policies and add sites and troubleshoot from websites issues on Palo Alto. Also check P2P connections, EIGRP, OSPF, BGP Peers and Azure Express Routes if they go down we investigate and call respective 3rd parties as per the circuit Information to these Peers.

• Work with PA TAC, Cisco TAC engineers to provide them with all the tech file and logs so that we can escalate it to our L3 engineers to further test and

troubleshoot.

• Also, we do initial check on the network devices (Switches, Firewalls and routers) when there is a connectivity issues within the internal network.

Call ISP to work in WAN issues.

Create LAN and WAN monitors when we on-board clients on ConnectWise Automate.

And we also we work on Network and Venerability Assessment for clients. Check with L3 Engineer and TAC team to recommend and make some

necessary changes with respect to Configurations, recommended IOS upgrade for network devices.

We help to pull network device backup from NCM for most of the Connect Wise Monitoring clients also have Logic Monitor to backup all Network

Devices clients host on LM on daily basis.

Also have some knowledge on Netbrain as one of the clients uses Netbrain to access their network devices. We usually use Secret Server to Access

Password and client details. We also use Jump server and Putty to access network devices.

Have worked with Palo Alto Panorama, we also push most of the policies and changes to PA firewall from Panorama. Have some go od basic knowledge

in Palo Alto Networks.

TOC Engineer ATSG, Bangalore, India

Mar 2020 - Oct 2020

Working as Toc engineer, here in ATSG we have 56 clients from USA. And we manage their Servers (Windows, Linux, ESX), Network devices (Switches,

Firewalls and routers),

Websites URLs. So, we basically manage all the client19s infrastructure by monitoring E them using tools like Logic Monitor, Solar winds, Application

Manager. As most of our client19s use Meraki devices we validate and check them here on Meraki dashboard. Also, we manage few validations on

Redicloud where we have hosted our collectors to fetch the alerts onto Logic Monitor dashboard and Azure for managing their VMs.

My responsibility as a T1 Engineer is to investigate all the alerts and validate them and if not, we route these alerts to T2 team.

And we also look into the antivirus reports and backup reports on daily basis validate these reports.

And we also monitor their patching, Job19s which are running on the server on daily basis. And follow up with the onsite engineer during

maintenance activity.

Software Analyst Capgemini, Bangalore, India

Mar 2018 - Mar 2020

Worked as a L2 support engineer and helped North European and American users with resolution for software related queries. Issues handled (VPN,

MS Office, Printers, Outlook, Antivirus, Encryption Tools, Team Room, SharePoint, Generic Mailbox, Distribution Lists, Software installation and windows

related queries.)

Worked as a Team lead for L1 support international Service desk and Voice desk. Involved in maintaining and managing a team where we were

supporting Europe region (Poland and Romania).

My responsibility was to maintain GOS, Abandon rate and AHT. Also maintain the quality of the agents who usually take calls on the service desk.

Also, my team was working for chat, I was supposed to maintain an Average answer time, No. of chats missed, analyses on the frequent queries

on chats to automate them so that the tool will answer to those queries.

Handling internal escalation emails, talking to service delivery managers for the process improvements.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering in Electronics and Communications Engineering, Nandi Institute of Technology and Management Sciences

Oct 2017

Completed my Electronics and Communications Engineering degree with an aggregate of 56.3%.

Higher Secondary, Nalanda English Medium School Bangalore, India

Apr 2010

Finished my Higher Secondary Education with 65% in Bangalore Karnataka.

CERTIFICATIONS

CISCO CERTIFIED NETWORK ASSOCIATE (CCNA) in ROUTING and SWITCHING, CISCO

Cisco ID: CSCO13527781

CISCO CERTIFIED NETWORK ASSOCIATE (CCNA) in Security, CISCO

Cisco ID: CSCO13527781

SKILLS

Good knowledge of Computer Networks (LAN, WAN) and OSI Reference model layers. Good understanding of Topologies. Good understanding of Network

Protocols suite (TCP/IP, FTP, DNS, DHCP). IP Address and Subnet mask. Basic Commands. Knowledge of Routing Protocols (Static routing and OSPF).

Knowledge of the NAT (NETWORK ADDRESS TRANSLATION). Switching Protocols (VLAN, VTP). Knowledge of Network Flow. Good knowledge in

creating Role-Based- CLI Access. Good knowledge in Privilege Levels. Basic Knowledge of Authentication, Authorization & Accounting (AAA) using CISCO

SECURE ACS. Good knowledge in Layer 2 Security (Port Security, Port fast, BPDU Guard, BPDU Filter and Root Guard). Good knowledge in DHCP

Snooping (Source Guard and Strom control). Good knowledge in IOS Access Control List (ACL). Knowledge in Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA

Firewall). Knowledge in IP Secure VPN (IP SEC). Knowledge in Secure Socket Layer VPN (SSL). Client SSL VPN. AnyConnect VPN.

Jan 2020
